name: home-cleaning
description: Cleaners are paid by the visit, and often come every week.

description.description: The cleaning, in the writer's words: what is cleaned, and how.

price.description: Each price the cleaner charges: per visit or per hour, with a count for a pack, such as 160 for 4 visits, and for a cleaner who takes no fewer than 3 hours, the pack alone, such as 45 for 3 hours; in a request, the most the client would pay.

frequency.description: How often the home is cleaned.

visitHours.description: How long one visit lasts, or the shortest and the longest, such as 3 to 4.

bedrooms.description: How many bedrooms the home has.

bathrooms.description: How many bathrooms the home has.

base.description: The area the cleaner works in: anywhere in the circle.

hours.description: When the cleaning can be done, each week.

time.description: When the first visit is wanted: a time, or a span to fit it in.

onTime.description: Whether the cleaner came at the time agreed.

paid.description: Whether the client paid for each visit as agreed.
